doc.title: Peter Ecklund interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998

title: Closing and joking about the set with three trumpet players
summary: Rowe wishes him luck, they joke about repertoire like 'Bugler's Holiday', and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I wish you a lot of luck with your future recordings and I hope that we run into you again at one of these festivals.
Yeah, well, nice talking to you.
And good luck coming up with a nicely balanced set, considering the line of horn players you’ve got to work with. © Fiillius Jazz Archive -14-
Right. I think it’s like three trumpet players or something like that. Maybe we’ll do “Carnival of Venice.”
As Tommy Newsom says, “That would be— this song’s called clear the room.”
Thanks for your time. © Fiillius Jazz Archive -15-
